info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Status API provides access to the current status of various fitness memberships. This endpoint allows clients to retrieve detailed information regarding active, expired, or pending memberships. Typical consumers include fitness centers and membership management systems that require up-to-date data for client services. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer relationship management.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current membership status for a user. The status may indicate whether the membership is active, expired, or pending renewal, providing necessary information for managing member privileges.
